StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:137-140) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ModifyBlockAdditive.maps_to: powers.py:4466-4474 FastenPower.modify_block_additive (hooks.py:797-, is_powered_card_or_monster_move_block self-gated at powers.py:4470)
ModifyBlockAdditive.rationale: +Amount to the owner's block from a Defend-tagged card. All three C# guards are present, one structurally: base.Owner != target (FastenPower.cs:22-25 vs powers.py:4472), !props.IsPoweredCardOrMonsterMoveBlock() (:26-29), which the power itself self-gates via `is_powered_card_or_monster_move_block(props)` (powers.py:4470, valueprops.py:52-56 -- REVISED 2026-08-04: the old citation 'cmds.py:146' now resolves to unrelated ShouldDie code and is dropped; the gate is per-listener, not centralised in BlockCmd, same correction as power/dexterity's matching guard) -- and `cardSource != null && !cardSource.Tags.Contains(CardTag.Defend)` (:30-33 vs :4472 `'defend' in card.tags`). Note C#'s third guard lets a NULL cardSource through (monster-move block) where the sim requires `card is not None`; that arm is unreachable for a player-owned Fasten, since no monster move grants the player block. Additive only, so no hook_dispatch G9 exposure -- G9 settled by execution that the additive family is exactly equal to C#'s running fold over integers.

AfterModifyingBlockAmount.rationale: FastenPower.cs:37-41's body is a single presentation statement (the one line the dump filter removes) followed by Task.CompletedTask -- no state change, no Decrement, unlike BufferPower's counterpart on the HP-loss family. Fasten is permanent: neither side ever ticks or removes it. So the sim's total absence of an after_modify_block_amount hook is the correct port here, and the missing MACHINERY (no out-param modifiers list on hooks.py:98-109's modify_block_additive, unlike modify_hp_lost at :126-147) is power_cmd G4's shape one family over and is recorded there rather than re-verdicted.

guards.rationale: The sim models card tags as a string set and tests 'defend' (powers.py:4472). Same predicate; the tag data is the cards' own and is audited by the card stream, not here.
FastenPower is applied by the Fasten card / rider; no AscensionHelper call in FastenPower.cs, so there is no non-ascension branch to pick.
